title: ABCoord: An Artificial Bee Colony (ABC)-Based Decentralized Distributed Two-Layer Decision-Making Architecture for the Coordination of AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.28103v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rapid progress in large language models (LLMs) is turning AI agents into multi-agent systems that jointly solve complex tasks, and the architecture that coordinates the agents toward a common goal is gaining fundamental importance in these systems. Since centralized architectures can become bottlenecks as the number of agents grows, whereas distributed architectures incur increasing communication costs, a decentralized coordination architecture that scales with low communication cost is needed. Recently, the structure of the artificial bee colony (ABC) algorithm has been defined for the first time as a two-layer decentralized information-processing and decision-making architecture. ABCoord is built on this proposed architecture. translated_title: ABCoord：一种基于人工蜂群（ABC）算法的去中心化分布式两层决策架构，用于AI智能体的协调
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.28103v1 公告类型：交叉。摘要：大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展正使AI智能体转变为多智能体系统，共同解决复杂任务，而将各智能体协调向共同目标的架构在这些系统中正获得根本性的重要地位。由于集中式架构会随着智能体数量的增长而成为瓶颈，而分布式架构则会产生不断攀升的通信成本，因此需要一种能够以低通信成本进行扩展的去中心化协调架构。最近，人工蜂群（ABC）算法的结构首次被定义为一种两层的去中心化信息处理与决策架构。ABCoord正是基于这一提出的架构构建的。结果表明，用于AI智能体协调的ABCoord，在BigCodeBench基准测试的自测条件（即测试由……）下，其表现与现有架构相当。
tldr: ABCoord首次将人工蜂群（ABC）算法结构实现为一种两层去中心化分布式决策架构，用于AI智能体的协调，能够以低通信成本实现可扩展的多智能体协作。
en_tdlr: ABCoord is the first two-layer decentralized distributed decision-making architecture based on the artificial bee colony (ABC) algorithm for coordinating AI agents, enabling scalable multi-agent collaboration with low communication costs.
